title: docs(spec, docs): App.defaultAgent and actions-as-tools name the agent route as the one chat door
body:
Fixes #21968

**Merge gate:** this PR merges only once objectstack-ai/cloud#2651 has merged. That PR removes the three assistant routes. Until it lands, the corrected text would be ahead of the server.

Clause-②: no

## What changed

The `App.defaultAgent` docblock and one docs callout named `POST /api/v1/ai/assistant/chat`, a route the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#2621 retires. Both texts now name the agent route, `POST /api/v1/ai/agents/:agentName/chat`, as the one chat door.

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`, the `App.defaultAgent` docblock.** It no longer says a server route reads the key. It now describes the reader that exists, objectui at the `.objectui-sha` pin `0abd4f9f87`: the chat dock passes the active app's `defaultAgent` to the console's one surface-to-agent resolver. That resolver honours the value only when it names `ask` or `build` (legacy aliases included) and otherwise falls back to the surface default. The resolved agent is then called by name on the agent route, where the `:agentName` path segment selects the agent. The sentence on the bare `POST /api/v1/ai/chat` route stays, shortened: it reads no agent, so the key does not scope it. The ADR-0063 surface-binding paragraph and the rule that only the two platform agents resolve are unchanged.
- **`content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx`.** The in-product chat-route callout lists the agent route only. It keeps its account of how the principal is taken from `req.user` and forwarded as `toolExecutionContext`.
- **Changeset** `@objectstack/spec` `patch`. Measured: after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, the new docblock text has 1 hit in each of `dist/ui/index.mjs` and `dist/ui/index.js`, and in the `dist/browser` bundles. The old route string has 0 hits in `dist`. The positive control, the unchanged ADR-0063 paragraph, has 1 hit in `dist/ui/index.mjs`. The package's `files` list also ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`. The `.d.ts` files do not carry the docblock.

No schema, parse, `.describe()`, export, type or accept-set change. `check:generated` confirms that no generated reference moved.

## How the console reads the key (objectui at `0abd4f9f87`, read-only)

- `ConsoleLayout.tsx` passes `activeApp?.defaultAgent` to the chat dock, both on desktop and in the mobile sheet.
- `ChatDock.tsx` (`ChatDockConversation`) calls `resolveSurfaceAgent('default', { agents, appDefaultAgent: defaultAgent, aiStudioEnabled, canAuthorMetadata })`. It posts to `apiBase/agents/NAME/chat`, with the resolved name URL-encoded.
- `surfaceAgent.ts` (`resolveSurfaceAgent`) runs these steps in order:
  1. It keeps the value only if `isBuiltinAgentName` holds. That means `build`, `metadata_assistant`, `ask` or `data_chat`. Any other value is dropped.
  2. With no kept value, the surface default applies: `build` on `studio-build`, `ask` everywhere else.
  3. A `build` request falls back to `ask` when AI Studio is off.
  4. An `ask` request becomes `build` for a principal who may author metadata, when the catalog serves `build`.
  5. The result is matched against the live catalog, alias-aware. If nothing matches, the catalog's platform default is used.

## Census of the three retired routes, and of claims that a server route reads `defaultAgent`

Searched at `c9761cd2fb` (`git grep`, outside `content/docs/releases/`):

| Hit | Lane | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:1658` | spec | moved with this card |
| `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx:275` | docs | moved with this card |
| `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md:29568`, `packages/client/CHANGELOG.md:3498`, `packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md:31673` | release-owned | listed, not edited. These are historical entries. |
| `packages/spec/liveness/agent.json:3` and `:70` cite cloud `routes/assistant-routes.ts#buildAssistantRoutes` | spec, ledger evidence | listed, not edited. They name the handler file, not a route path, and are anchored at `cloud @cb8ee7ff`, where they stay true. `planning.maxIterations` is still live through `agent-routes.ts` and `eval-runner.ts`. This lane cannot read cloud to re-anchor them. |

`skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**` and `examples/**` have zero hits for the three routes. No text in `content/docs`, `skills` or `examples` says a server route reads `defaultAgent`. No test asserts the docblock text, so no needle moves.

## Tests

All runs are at `7f6089bd50` (HEAD). The spec build was taken at `4e79442153`, whose source is the same; the build-input stamp matched.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0, "All 15 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `vitest run --project local` over the six `src/ui/app*.test.ts` files: 6 files, 203 tests passed. This is a declared narrowing. The diff is a comment in `app.zod.ts`, so the full spec suite is left to CI.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 101 derived, 100 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
  - Five gates first refused with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift` and `check:lean-entry-closure`. After a build of formula, lint, client, client-react and objectql, all five exited 0.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: it needs `dist` for the whole workspace (87 packages). As a narrowed stand-in, all 19 `require` entries of `@objectstack/spec` load. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs the full gate.
  - The six artifact-roster gates flagged under my paths also exited 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:meta-url-spelling` and `check:spec-changes`.
- **Lint, narrowed:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the two edited source files.
  - Population, read from eslint's own answer: `app.zod.ts` is linted, with 0 errors and 0 warnings. The `.mdx` file is outside the population ("no matching configuration").
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` never enables type-aware linting (it has no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the result for any file it does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui's `AiChatPage.tsx` also takes a `defaultAgent` prop, and resolves it with `resolveDefaultAgentName`, which is not bounded to `ask` / `build`. But the console mounts it in `apps/console/src/App.tsx` with no props, so `app.defaultAgent` never reaches it there. The docblock therefore describes only the dock path. This is noted, not filed: nothing passes the key down that path. Carrier: none.
- Whether `defaultAgent` needs a server consumer is not this card's question (triage).
